headline.purpose: Product name; the single most important reading on a panel.

title.purpose: Panel titles and the Export button label.

body.purpose: Default text, table cells, field values, panel metadata.

label.purpose: Button labels, slider readouts, in-progress counts, the selected row.

caption.purpose: Axis times, table headings, track durations, quiet header text.

caption-strong.purpose: File chip, invalid message, split numbers and chips.

motion.name: control-colors
motion.purpose: Hover and state colour change on buttons and icon buttons; nothing else animates.

focusRing.purpose: Keyboard focus on every control; on-vinyl on the header band, on-track on a track block, split on an invalid field.

disabled.purpose: Every disabled control (the slider via data-disabled); hover is gated by :enabled.

icons.note: Play drawn filled (fill currentColor, no stroke). Used so far: Play, ChevronsLeft, ChevronsRight, Trash2, Plus, Download. Unicode glyphs are never icons.

canvas.wave: wave bars 2px wide on a 3px pitch
canvas.land: land band with no waveform; at least 12px wide in whole-file views
canvas.split: 1.5px split line; selected 3px plus a 20px filled split chip with on-split number
canvas.splitNumbers: 22px band above the whole-file waveform, numbers in split
canvas.zoomWindow: 1.5px ink outline in the whole-file view, matching the zoom view frame
canvas.loudness: 1.5px wave line, 14% wave fill beneath, lands full height behind
canvas.threshold: dashed 5/4, 1.5px, split; label on a surface plate (text width + 8px, 17px tall); 18x10 drag handle at the right edge
canvas.zoom: land band with a flat 1px wave run-out line; 3px split line with a 14x10 handle at the top; 1.5px ink frame

narrative.overview:
On a record you can see where one track ends: the textured groove bands stop and a smooth land runs between them. Audio Splitter draws a source file the same way. Tracks are dense grey waveform bands, every gap is a flat land, and a split reads as something you can see before you read a number. The world refuses the dark audio editor with a bright blue waveform, the studio-gear look, decoration that competes with the waveforms, and dense tiny technical type.

By day the ground is sleeve white and the panels are white; by night the ground is vinyl black and the panels near-black. Ink is vinyl black, inverted at night. Waveforms and track blocks are groove grey, lands are sheen grey, and one centre-label vermilion marks splits and the silence threshold. Colour is flat: no gradients, no shadows. Panels separate by a hairline and the ground between them. The theme follows the system setting; there is no theme toggle.

The waveforms and the loudness curve are the content, so the chrome is quiet: one face (Manrope) with tabular figures, two radii, a 16 px rhythm, and controls that carry state through ink and border rather than colour. Motion is limited to a 100 ms colour transition on controls.
keyCharacteristics: Groove grey for everything that is audio; sheen-grey lands for every gap.
One reserved vermilion: splits, the silence threshold, danger and invalid states, and the centre-label mark in the header.
A vinyl-black header band in both themes.
Flat colour throughout; depth comes from ground versus surface and a 1 px hairline.
Manrope everywhere, tabular figures everywhere, nothing smaller than 12 px.
Hand-drawn canvas views read the same colour tokens as the kit.

rules.name: The Centre-Label Rule
rules.body: Vermilion marks a split, the silence threshold, a destructive action, an invalid value, or the centre-label mark in the header, and nothing else: not hover, not selection, not links, not emphasis, not a progress fill.

rules.name: The Vinyl Band Rule
rules.body: The header band is vinyl black with on-vinyl text in both themes; its tokens never take dark-mode overrides.

rules.name: The Groove Grey Rule
rules.body: Audio is drawn in groove grey. A waveform, curve or track block is never coloured, never blue, never vermilion.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` is set once on `body` and is never switched off; every time, gap, count and dB value is tabular.

rules.name: The Twelve-Pixel Floor
rules.body: Nothing is set below 12 px, and nothing is uppercased or letter-spaced to look technical.

rules.name: The Full-Strength Text Rule
rules.body: Text hierarchy comes from size, weight and the `muted` token, never from opacity on text.

rules.name: The Flat Sleeve Rule
rules.body: No `box-shadow`, no `drop-shadow`, no gradient, no blur, no translucency over content. If something needs to stand apart, it gets the surface colour, a hairline, or ground around it.

rules.name: The Two Radii Rule
rules.body: 6 px for anything you press or type into, 8 px for a panel, fully round only for tracks, thumbs, bars and chips. No other radius.

rules.name: The Land Rule
rules.body: A gap is always drawn as land, never as waveform, and never narrower than 12 px in a whole-file view.

rules.name: The Shared Token Rule
rules.body: Canvas code never hard-codes a colour; it reads the `--color-…` variables, so canvases and kit change theme together.

rules.name: The Ink Focus Rule
rules.body: Keyboard focus is always a 2 px outline at 2 px offset in the ink of its ground (`ink`, `on-vinyl` on the header band, `on-track` on a track block, `split` on an invalid field).

dos: Do take every colour, radius and text size from the token block; add a token before adding a one-off value.
Do follow the system theme through `prefers-color-scheme` alone.
Do draw every gap as a land, at least 12 px wide in whole-file views, and keep audio in groove grey.
Do keep vermilion for splits, the silence threshold, danger, invalid states and the header's centre-label mark.
Do read canvas colours from the `--color-…` variables and redraw when the colour scheme changes.
Do give every control a visible keyboard focus ring (2 px outline, 2 px offset) and every icon button an `aria-label`.
Do use `lucide-vue-next` icons at 16 px with a 2 px round stroke.
Do keep figures tabular and text at 12 px or larger.
Do reserve the large button size for the Export action.
donts: Don't use gradients, shadows, blur or translucency over content.
Don't draw a bright blue (or any coloured) waveform, or dress the screen as studio gear.
Don't use vermilion for hover, selection, links, emphasis, progress or branding beyond the centre-label mark.
Don't add a theme toggle or a `data-theme` switch.
Don't fetch fonts or any other asset from the network at runtime.
Don't use Unicode glyphs as icons.
Don't dim text with opacity to make hierarchy; use `muted`, size or weight.
Don't set text below 12 px, or uppercase and letter-space labels to look technical.
Don't introduce a third radius or a second typeface.
